Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Corefix 100 heavy duty steel-reinforced fixing for dot and dab (plasterboard over blockwork) walls. Suitable for all brick and block types, including lightweight blockwork. Ideal for fixing brackets, shelves and heavy items such as TVs, wall units, boilers and radiators. Offers 55kg safe working load per single fixing (safety factor 2). Steel core bridges the gap behind the plasterboard and transfers load to the solid blockwork and prevents the plasterboard crushing. Maximum distance of 45mm from outer face of wall to blockwork behind.
b: Heavy Duty Dot & Dab Wall Fixing
Steel Core Transfers Load to Blockwork
55kg Safe Working Load per Single Fixing
Suitable for All Brick & Block Types
Suitable for Max. 10mm Bracket / Fixture Thickness
